title: econ-config-lab-prefetch-dyngroup-experiment-platform
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an experimentation harness and dashboarding for validating automated configuration recommendations that control request grouping (dynamic minibatching) and KV/prefix prefetch behavior. Goal: safely quantify unit-cost improvements and user-facing latency/regression risk before automated rollout. Deliverables: 1) experiment runner that can incubate candidate configs for dyn-grouping + prefetch heuristics as A/B cohorts, 2) a suite of metrics/guardrails, 3) an analysis notebook and dashboards for SRE/PMs to approve rollouts, 4) automated rollback hooks and a playbook for edge-case failures. Key constraints: minimal perturbation to production tail-latency, strong statistical inference for stratified cohorts (traffic type, sequence length, model family), and integration with the existing feature-flag + canary mesh orchestration.
success_criteria: >=5% reduction in cost_per_1k_tokens_usd with no regression in p95_latency_ms > 5%
statistical significance p<0.01 for primary cost metric across stratified cohorts
experiment_design: Randomized cohort assignment at edge router by tenant slice; two arms: control (current config) and candidate (dyn-grouping + prefetch params). Stratify by model_family, avg_seq_len_bucket, and customer_tier. Run minimum 7 days to capture weekday variation or until N effective requests per stratum is met. Use sequential hypothesis testing with alpha spending (O'Brien-Fleming) to allow early stop for safety or clear wins. Backfill per-request telemetry into experiment DB and run daily aggregation pipelines. Include shadow traffic path to validate no behavioral divergence before turning on live cohorts.
dashboard_queries: SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 50) FROM requests WHERE cohort='candidate' AND model='...'
SELECT cost_per_1k_tokens_usd, COUNT(*) FROM tokens GROUP BY cohort, model_family
SELECT avg(kv_prefetch_hit_rate) FROM per_request_metrics WHERE cohort='candidate' GROUP BY day, seq_len_bucket
rollback_playbook: Automated rollback triggers: immediate auto-rollback when any safety_gate breached for two consecutive 5-minute windows OR when on-call acknowledges an incident. Rollback path: 1) feature flag flip to control for cohorts, 2) automated reprovision of previous runtime config via orchestration service, 3) emit incident ticket with pre-filled diagnostics (cohort id, time window, top affected routes). Manual checklists for SRE/PM: validate traffic rebalancing, confirm cost delta reversal within 30 minutes, run sanity queries on cache hit rates.
comments: 2026-03-03: Initial spike completed. Validated per-request telemetry schema includes kv_prefetch_hit_rate and dyn_group_size. Minor changes to tracing headers required (PR submitted).

2026-03-05: Design review with PM and SRE. Decision: stratify by model_family and seq_len_bucket; require O'Brien-Fleming alpha spending for sequential testing. PM requested cost uplift sensitivity table for top 10 customers.

2026-03-07: Engineering implementation notes: added cohort assignment at edge-proxy layer to avoid downstream routing churn; need one extra DB index for experiment_id+model_family aggregates (impact: small storage, big perf win).

2026-03-09: Observatory work-in-progress: summary dashboard prototype wired to bigquery exports. Early shadow-run results show 6.2% cost reduction in long-tail cohort, p95 latency unchanged within noise for most models. Need extended run for short-seq cohort where variance higher.

2026-03-11: SRE vulnerability callout: under heavy concurrency, dyn-grouping increased queue_time_ms spikes for low-tier tenants. Agreed to cap group size for 'tier:free' to mitigate. Added cap as temporary safeguard in candidate config.
2026-03-12: PM accepted canary gating thresholds. Next: schedule 25% randomized canary starting 2026-03-14 for 72 hours then evaluate.
notes_for_review: Requesting review from data-science on sequential testing implementation and from SRE on rollback latency SLAs. Ops to confirm bigquery export quotas for per-request telemetry ingestion.
acceptance_criteria: experiment runner can split traffic 50/50 with less than 0.5% routing error
dashboard shows aggregated metrics by stratum and cohort within 2 hours of ingestion
automated rollback triggers execute end-to-end in the test environment
